inputs.causal_hypothesis: Data-centre power-density and interconnection constraints can increase demand for Schneider Electric electrical panels, UPS, power distribution, cooling integration, and energy-management systems, subject to project timing, competition, capacity, concentration, and valuation.
inputs.research_focus: Validate identity, data-centre revenue and order exposure, electrical-panel and UPS economics, capacity, customer concentration, cash conversion, valuation, catalysts, and invalidation.

objective: Research Schneider Electric as a bounded data-centre electrical-distribution and energy-management exposure.
